one_liner_zh: RTX Corporation 2026年第二季財報表現強勁，營收與每股盈餘雙雙擊敗市場預期。
one_liner_en: RTX Corporation reported strong Q2 2026 results, beating consensus estimates on both revenue and earnings per share.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，受惠於國防與航太需求強勁，EPS 超出預期 13.71%
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘達 1.89 美元，高於市場預期的 1.66 美元。
季度營收達 247.1 億美元，年增率達 14.49%。
國防與商用航空業務需求持續穩健擴張。
highlights_en: Quarterly revenue hit $24.71B, representing a 14.49% year-over-year increase.
Robust demand continued across both defense and commercial aerospace segments.
risks_zh: 全球供應鏈瓶頸與零組件成本上升壓力。
地緣政治與國防預算政策變動的不確定性。
risks_en: Ongoing global supply chain bottlenecks and rising component cost pressures.
Uncertainties surrounding geopolitical shifts and defense budget policy changes.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：本季財報展現強勁的營運執行力與國防需求韌性。訊號偏向正面，有助於支撐中短期股價表現。追蹤指標應關注供應鏈交期改善狀況與後續國防訂單能見度。
ai_view_en: View: The earnings report demonstrates strong operational execution and robust defense demand resilience. The signal is positive, supporting near-to-mid-term stock performance. Key tracking metrics include supply chain lead time improvements and future defense order visibility.
